purpose: Submission evidence recomputed from existing retained predictions, without new training or inference

sources.title: Pamungkas et al. 2026. Decoding hate in memes: multimodal and multitask approaches for low-resource Indonesian social media
sources.access_note: Publisher page and PDF returned HTTP 403 during final check. Primary article text cached from official browser on 18 October 2026 remains available locally.

dataset.group_split: First fold StratifiedGroupKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=42), stratified on joint label, grouping three exact-image duplicate pairs within official train

preprocessing: Use published images, OCR, captions and annotated topics; do not regenerate OCR/captions or collect/reannotate memes.
Verify Parquet SHA-256, decode all 5023 images and cross-check CSV labels/fields against the official supplement.
Convert image to RGB and use the pinned ViT image processor for the 224-in21k checkpoint.
For Caption+OCR+Topic, code concatenates nonempty topic, caption and OCR in that order using the tokenizer separator [SEP] for IndoBERTweet.
Tokenizer pads to max length 256 and truncates longer sequences. No stemming/stop-word removal is applied by the transformer pipeline.
Missing topic nan becomes empty string for training input and none/others only for statistical tabulation.
Positive hate label is hate. Positive appropriate-task label is inappropriate. Topic annotations are privileged released inputs, not automatically available at deployment.
Official test is unchanged. Exact duplicates are grouped only inside train/validation; two exact train/test duplicate groups remain as a known limitation.

protocol.multitask_selection: Highest mean(validation hate macro-F1, validation constrained inappropriate macro-F1)

hate.selection_basis: Highest per-task validation macro-F1 among the eight fixed configurations at each run's already selected checkpoint. Test is descriptive only.

appropriate.selection_basis: Highest per-task validation macro-F1 among the eight fixed configurations at each run's already selected checkpoint. Test is descriptive only.

limitations: Eight prespecified supervised configurations out of 90, not complete paper/grid reproduction. RQ3/API and novel models are excluded.
One seed, no confidence intervals or significance claim, no hyperparameter/lambda sweep.
Batch/accumulation, validation construction, early stopping, ViT checkpoint and pooling details deviate from or require clarification against the author source.
Provided topic annotation is privileged input; results do not describe an end-to-end system predicting topics for new memes.
Two exact-image groups cross official train/test split (four rows, two test memes). Original split retained for comparability; near-duplicate search was not performed.
Quantitative errors do not establish semantic causes such as sarcasm, OCR quality or cultural context without manual annotation.
Cross-configuration candidate selection is an explicit submission interpretation of the prespecified validation evidence, not a new training decision or test-based model search.
